title: Opposite operations
text: The variable is on one side with a constant multiple. Remove the constant by dividing by the multiple.

title: Balance both sides
text: We multiply the left side by $$-6$$ to isolate the variable; we must multiply the right side by $$-6$$ to keep the equation balanced. \n $$\left(-6\right) \frac{z}{\left(-6\right)}=(-6)(-2)$$
